verdict.rationale: Bruno's own docs say it keeps credentials out of version control with secret variables and vaults. They also document external secret-manager integrations: Azure Key Vault, including Azure CLI authentication, and GCP Secret Manager support added in a release. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how secrets are masked in the UI or on disk, independent or hands-on corroboration of the vault integrations, and evidence of other common vaults (e.g., HashiCorp, AWS).
